policy: MINIMAL BY DESIGN. This register is a backstop, not the primary source. The live search path (release_crosswalk resolve) is authoritative; entries here only seed offline/low-signal runs and supply Salesforce-named successors when live capture misses. Every entry MUST carry a Salesforce-controlled salesforce_source (R23), an as_of date, and a review_by date. Do NOT grow this into an exhaustive catalogue — add an entry only when a mechanism is both (a) commonly named in SDDs and (b) has a confirmed Salesforce lifecycle event. Stale entries are auto-flagged when live evidence contradicts them (register_stale).

entries.supersession: Migrate to Flow Builder (Record-Triggered Flow). Existing Workflow Rules continue to run after 2025-12-31, but Salesforce no longer provides support or bug fixes.
entries.consequence: Unsupported technical debt: continues running, but no support or bug fixes. Not a deployment blocker.
entries.evidence_note: Salesforce KB: End of Support 2025-12-31 — explicitly NOT a retirement. Processes keep running.

entries.supersession: Upgrade to a supported (current GA) API version. Resolve the current GA version live at run time rather than hardcoding a number.
entries.consequence: Blocking: calls on these versions fail (REST 410 GONE / SOAP 500 UNSUPPORTED_API_VERSION / Bulk 400 InvalidVersion). The design will not function.
entries.evidence_note: Retired in the Summer '25 release (previously deprecated Summer '22). Versions 7.0-20.0 retired Summer '22.

entries.supersession: Migrate to OAuth 2.0 with Named Credentials. The username-password login() operation is scheduled to be retired 2027-06-01 across all API versions.
entries.consequence: Scheduled retirement 2027-06-01: username-password authentication will cease to function for all API versions. Plan migration before the sunset.
entries.evidence_note: Announced SOAP login() retirement; affects all API versions, not only legacy ones.

entries.supersession: Build new components as Lightning Web Components (LWC). Aura is in maintenance mode; LWC is the recommended path for new development.
entries.consequence: Outdated pattern for greenfield: Aura still works but new components should be LWC. Not a deployment blocker.
entries.evidence_note: Salesforce Developer guidance: LWC is the modern, recommended component model; Aura is maintenance-mode.

entries.supersession: Design for Lightning Experience. Salesforce Classic is in long-term wind-down; new design should target Lightning Experience.
entries.consequence: Outdated UI target: design against Lightning Experience rather than Classic.
entries.evidence_note: Lightning Experience is the current and recommended UI; Classic is being phased out.
